certified_mean_interface.exact_C2_primitive: H(s)=H(a)+integral_a^s m(t)dt for m continuously differentiable
certified_mean_interface.simple_position_error: < (b-a)^2*osc_[a,b](m')/40 when the oscillation is positive; equality zero for affine m
certified_mean_interface.internal_knot_first_jet_jump: At b, the right derivative of the next partial primitive is m(b); absolute jump <= (b-a)*osc_[a,b](m')/2.
certified_mean_interface.sum_rule: Sum the position bounds over every completed original interval and the final partial interval; do not replace different old/fine quadrature meshes by a common difference rule without paying that change.
certified_mean_interface.complete_mean: m may be the exact continuous angular average or one specified finite equal-weight angular functional. They are different choices; their conversion and finite evaluation roundoff are separate inputs.
certified_mean_interface.finite_rule_perturbation: For h=b-a, max normalized node error eta, total absolute weight error omega, |m|<=M, |m'|<=L, sample errors epsilon_i: |h Q6(m)-h Qhat(mhat)| <= h*omega*M+h^2*eta*L+h*sum_i |what_i| epsilon_i. All actual normalized nodes must lie in [0,1]; endpoint mapping and cumulative-sum rounding remain separate.
